description: Identification des secteurs routiers mortels pour les amphibiens de Picardie is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Picardie Nature. Since 2011, the association has launched an investigation to identify points of conflict for amphibians on roads. In 2012, with the launch of the tool “[Faund and Roads] ( new sectors were identified. Coverage: Picardie Nature. The portal shows the English title as "Identification of deadly road areas for Picardy amphibians" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Picardie Nature. Its keywords include faune-sauvage, route, risques, collecte-citoyenne. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, KML. The listing shows 2016-04-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
